maximum.songTitle: I Loved Being My Mother’s Son
maximum.line: I loved her to the maximum
stanza: She helped me walk, she watched me run
She got where I was coming from
And when I couldn't count my friends on a single thumb
I loved her to the maximum

maximum.line: You've got to spread joy up to the maximum
stanza: You've got to spread joy up to the maximum
Bring gloom down to the minimum
Liable to walk upon the scene
